title: ZSynth
summary: Pocket groovebox: synths, mic sampler, drums, patterns and songs
description:
ZSynth turns the Cardputer Zero into a pocket groovebox.

Four tracks: a lead synth, a bass synth, a mic sampler and a drum kit. Each song has eight patterns, from 1 to 32 steps in any time signature (4/4, 3/4, 7/8, 6/8...), and a chain that plays them in order.

- Play live: arm recording and play along while the loop runs, with a metronome.
- Step editing: a drum-machine grid with accents, and a piano roll for writing notes and chords step by step.
- Sound design: shape each track on the Sound screen (wave, filter, envelope, detune), and hear changes as you play.
- Instrument library: 23 starter instruments. Browse them while your loop plays to hear each one in context, and save your own.
- Sampler: record up to 5 seconds from the built-in mic, or use the 18 starter samples (FM piano, harpsichord, marimba, kalimba, tenor sax, harmonica, gong and more) from the CC0 Versilian Community Sample Library, tuned to play across the keyboard.
- Comes with a demo song, night-shift: 87 seconds of dance-punk at 118 BPM.

Everything is saved as you go. Press Fn+H in the app for the key guide.
